claims.summary: Characteristic zero, M>=3, non-integer lambda, generic P=(x-u)^2Q. For the rescaled neck matrix, W_k is the unique minimizer of Phi_alpha on (k/M,(k+1)/M) for k<=M-3, W_(M-2) on ((M-2)/M,1), and W_(M-2), W_(M-1), W_M attain the minimum at alpha=1. Hence the half-integral cross rows of the confluent cluster degeneration have exactly the M-2 binomial neck edges of slopes j/M (2M(M-2) simple roots) and then an edge of slope 1 through W_(M-2), W_(M-1), W_M.
claims.assessment: Working proof: Case B reduced by completing the clearing with the omitted u-rows, a row-plus-column parity of every entry, and the left kernel R -> R'(u) of the leading block for j>=M-1; exhaustive minimization over all 2M-sets in a column range at M=3 agrees.
claims.rationale: Determines the confluent neck completely below slope 1 and places the 2M displaced points at the cluster scale.

relationships: Top window valuations and the Case A corollary.
